dbi-services:easy-transport-of-sql-tunin: OEM lets you export a SQL Tuning Set to a DataPump dump file via a directory object and import it elsewhere, but importing over an existing STS name is not allowed and requires the Tuning Pack license.
dbi-services:gtt-in-exadata-are-eligible: Tests show Exadata SmartScan predicate offloading also works on Global Temporary Tables, verified with the internal filter-predicate library and forced serial direct path reads on a GTT populated from dba_objects.
dbi-services:standard-edition-2-testing-: On a 32-thread cloud VM running Standard Edition 2 in 12.1.0.2, only 16 of 32 concurrently active sessions could run in CPU at once, confirming the new 16-thread cap introduced for SE2.
dbi-services:the-taboo-of-underscore-par: Argues hidden underscore parameters are not inherently dangerous since Oracle, ISVs, and appliances like ODA and Exadata rely on them, and shows V$PARAMETER's 381 rows come from a query against X$KSPPI and X$KSPPCV.
dbi-services:12c-online-datafile-move-an: Explains that ALTER DATABASE MOVE DATAFILE needs no lock; sessions writing to already-copied blocks just double-write until completion, with progress tracked via V$SESSION_LONGOPS.
dbi-services:sql-plan-directives-strike-: Walks through diagnosing a post-12c-migration slowdown via AWR time model and SQL ordered by Parse Calls, tracing excessive hard parsing back to SQL Plan Directives triggering dynamic sampling.
dbi-services:awrrpt-and-spreport-in-mult: Notes that running awrrpt.sql from inside a PDB under-captures SQL because AWR gathers statistics at CDB level, so per-PDB reports show a lower captured-SQL percentage than the CDB-level report.
dbi-services:ofe-optimizer-features-enab: Compares optimizer_features_enable to runtime feature-flag versioning of the optimizer code, questioning whether setting it to an older release value during a 12c upgrade is safe or reckless.
dbi-services:execution-plan-with-ash: Shares a query joining V$SQL, V$ACTIVE_SESSION_HISTORY and dbms_xplan.display_cursor to annotate each plan line with its share of ASH samples, useful when Diagnostic Pack is licensed but Tuning Pack is not.
dbi-services:datapump-processing-object-: Using Data Pump LOGTIME=ALL timestamps, shows the 'Processing object type TABLE_STATISTICS' message doesn't reflect when the preceding TABLE_DATA export actually finished.
dbi-services:log-file-sync-user-commits: Corrects an earlier presentation slide, explaining that dividing 'log file sync' wait time by 'user commits' is misleading since each commit triggers one wait regardless of how quickly redo was already on disk.
dbi-services:flashback-table-after-multi: Demonstrates FLASHBACK TABLE restoring older recycle-bin versions after a table was dropped and recreated six times, using USER_RECYCLEBIN's DROPSCN ordering to pick a specific prior incarnation.
dbi-services:pdb-snapshot-using-dbms_dnf: Shows getting thin-provisioned PDB snapshot copies on a single non-multitenant-licensed CDB using dbms_dnfs.clonedb_renamefile, cloning before unplugging since plug-in rewrites file headers.
dbi-services:pdb-snapshot-copy-for-conti: Argues multitenant lets continuous-integration tests reset state faster than flashback database, because closing and reopening a PDB avoids the instance restart flashback database requires.
dbi-services:phantom-session-environment: Finds that an ALTER SYSTEM SET ... SCOPE=MEMORY parameter change survives switching CONTAINER within the same session, but is lost once the PDB is closed and reopened, reverting to default.
dbi-services:ocm-12c-preparation-restore: OCM exam prep notes on restoring OCR from ocrconfig backup listings and stopping/starting Grid Infrastructure with crsctl, referencing MOS note 1062983.1 for voting disk and ASM spfile recovery.
dbi-services:ocm-12c-preparation-rat-in-: Real Application Testing capture in Enterprise Manager only operates at CDB level even when launched from a PDB, and replay against a recreated SCOTT schema fails with ORA-01918 and ORA-65049 in CDB$ROOT.
dbi-services:ocm-12c-preparation-data-gu: Documents recovering from a failed OEM-driven Data Guard creation job by using DGMGRL directly once the broker configuration exists, including converting a standby to snapshot standby.
dbi-services:ocm-12c-preparation-documen: Maps each OCM 12c upgrade exam topic to the exact Oracle documentation book and chapter to search during the exam, since GUI tools may lack sufficient built-in help under exam conditions.
dbi-services:ocm-12c-preparation-explain: Walks through creating materialized view logs with primary key and sequence/ROWID clauses so a join-and-group-by materialized view on SCOTT.DEPT/EMP becomes fast-refreshable, checked via EXPLAIN.
dbi-services:ocm-12c-preparation-transpo: Traces transportable tablespaces to a 1997 patent for 'plugged-in' tablespaces, noting 12c pluggable databases extend TTS by also transporting SYSTEM, and demonstrates read-only tablespace prep.
dbi-services:sql-plan-directive-disablin: Clarifies that disabling a SQL Plan Directive's usage stops the dynamic sampling it triggers but not dbms_stats still creating column-group extended statistics from a MISSING_STATS directive.
dbi-services:ocm-12c-preparation-manage-: Enumerates the ways to create a PDB, from PDB$SEED, another local or remote PDB, an unplugged PDB, or a non-CDB, and shows SQL Developer's object-oriented menus alongside the statement-based documentation.
dbi-services:ocm-12c-preparation-create-: Walks through manually creating a CDB from the command line with orapwd and a CREATE DATABASE statement instead of dbca, as preparation for the rarely-used manual path tested on the OCM exam.
dbi-services:trying-appdynamix-monitorin: First trial of AppDynamics' 15-day Linux controller, installed from a 500MB self-extracting shell script with an embedded license file, tested for tracing from user requests down to the database.
dbi-services:real-life-audience-vs-twitt: Compares Twitter impression and engagement counts against actual in-person attendance at several events, noting the top tweet was about Standard Edition 2 licensing yet its event drew a modest crowd.
dbi-services:in-memory-synchronous-popul: Shows In-Memory Column Store population is asynchronous by default via background IMCO and Wnnn processes, and demonstrates forcing synchronous population with an undocumented parameter.
dbi-services:cloud-control-12c-on-your-l: Explains downloading Oracle's prebuilt multi-file OVA for Enterprise Manager Cloud Control 12.1.0.5 with an 11.2.0.4 repository, concatenating the split ova parts before importing into VirtualBox.
dbi-services:interested-in-a-deep-dive-o: Announces a hands-on RepAttack session at DOAG2015 where attendees install a Dbvisit Replicate trial with Oracle XE on their own laptop from a distributed USB stick, mirroring the RAC Attack format.
dbi-services:_rowsets_enabled: Documents a 12c wrong-results bug fixed by disabling the rowsets feature via an underscore parameter, referencing Mike Dietrich's write-up and recommending the workaround be commented for later removal.
dbi-services:awr-when-ash-cpu-db-cpu: Demonstrates in a 4-core VM how CPU starvation appears in an AWR report: one session alone uses 25% of host CPU, but adding four competing OS processes makes ASH show waiting for CPU instead of steady DB CPU.
dbi-services:rman-channels-in-rac: Explains allocating RMAN channels across multiple RAC nodes to exceed a single node's HBA throughput ceiling against a 3GB/s XtremIO array, noting an unusual need to disable cell offload processing even off Exadata.
dbi-services:dbvisit-replicate-allows-dd: Demonstrates Dbvisit Replicate continuing to replicate DML correctly after adding differently sized columns independently to source and target tables, unlike position-based replication tools.
dbi-services:ibm-bluemix-database-cloud-: First hands-on trial of IBM Bluemix's SQL Database service, loading EMP and DEPT CSV exports from Oracle's SCOTT schema through the web console's default import options.
dbi-services:dba-turkeys-and-nosql-hype: Reacting to a Swiss BI Day talk framing DBAs as biased against NoSQL, argues DBAs should engage with real Big Data requirements rather than dismiss them, to keep the credibility of decades of ACID experience.
dbi-services:sql-alter-database-switchov: Compares alert.log output from a manual single-command switchover in 12c against a broker-driven switchover, finding the broker internally still issues the older two-step commit-to-switchover sequence.
dbi-services:oracle-cloud-service-my-fir: Recounts a planned Oracle Cloud Service maintenance window that rebooted the VM rather than the expected save and restore of running state, verified from the last command showing a mid-session restart.
dbi-services:you-are-in-standard-edition: Explains the December 2015 Standard Edition licensing changes tripling minimum pricing and halving the socket cap to two, detailing how sockets are counted differently for single instance versus RAC.
dbi-services:11-2-0-4-support-dont-worry: Clarifies Oracle's premier, extended, and sustaining support tiers, confirming 11.2.0.4 keeps premier support at no extra cost until May 2017 without assuming it is more stable than 12.1.0.2.
dbi-services:mapping-in-memory-cu-to-val: Uses V$IM_COL_CU to show how each In-Memory Compression Unit stores per-column min and max values enabling IMCU pruning and skip filtering, similar in effect to Exadata Storage Indexes.
dbi-services:mapping-in-memory-column-st: Uses V$IM_SMU_HEAD to map In-Memory Compression Units back to their originating row-store datafile extents via relative DBA and tablespace number, showing how IMCS metadata references blocks.
dbi-services:in-memory-trickle-repopulat: Demonstrates that DML against an In-Memory table invalidates rows in the IMCU asynchronously via SMU logging, with background trickle repopulation refreshing compression units rather than in-place index updates.
dbi-services:dbvisit-replicate-cdc-witho: Configures Dbvisit Replicate's change-data-capture wizard to write only new values, not before-images, into an audit table with matching column names plus added operation, timestamp, and SCN metadata columns.
dbi-services:oracle-in-memory-column-sto: Slide deck from a Swiss BI Day talk on using the Oracle In-Memory Column Store to accelerate analytic queries for business intelligence workloads, shared afterward on SlideShare.
dbi-services:oracle-and-analytic-queries: Defines analytic queries as needing few columns but many rows versus OLTP's single-row-by-primary-key pattern, surveying the optimization techniques Oracle used before In-Memory Column Store existed.
dbi-services:result-cache-and-12c-fetch-: Shows an execution plan where a result-cache-hinted query with 12c FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY still materializes and caches the full 100K-row window function result before applying the row limit.
dbi-services:query-vundostat-for-relevan: Explains that when an ORA-01555 fires, the alert.log gives the query's start SCN and duration, showing how to convert that hex SCN into a timestamp to correlate against V$UNDOSTAT for the relevant window.
dbi-services:nothing-in-feature-usage-st: Traces a gap in Database Feature Usage tracking after a 12c migration to MMON's feature-usage collection job repeatedly hitting ORA-12751 after 20 minutes of CPU, caused by a dynamic-sampling-heavy internal query.
dbi-services:do-you-use-sql-plan-baselin: Argues that OLTP plan instability from adaptive features such as SPD, ADS, cardinality feedback, and bind peeking should be controlled with SQL Plan Baselines rather than disabling optimizer features wholesale.
dbi-services:you-are-in-standard-edition: Confirms that moving from Standard Edition One to Standard Edition Two costs no upgrade fee beyond a 20% higher annual maintenance, while gaining RAC eligibility and current patchsets.
dbi-services:invisible-indexes-its-onlin: Demonstrates that marking an index invisible before dropping it is an online operation available even in Standard Edition in 12c, letting you safely test its removal before a full drop.
dbi-services:waiting-for-row-lock-but-wh: Shows that a session blocked on row lock contention can identify the exact locked row via V$SESSION's row-wait columns, cautioning that ROW_WAIT_OBJ# is actually the DATA_OBJECT_ID, not OBJECT_ID.
dbi-services:database-cloud-service-perf: Sets up SSH port-forwarding of 1521 to reach an Oracle Database Cloud Service instance, measuring roughly 90ms latency from Switzerland to the Amsterdam region versus 240ms to the US region.
dbi-services:windows-10-i-tried-and-came: Recounts rolling back from Windows 10 after VirtualBox failed to create host-only network interfaces from both the GUI and command line, making the required labs and demo environment unusable.
dbi-services:measuring-iops-on-xtremio: Compares EMC XtremIO's own dashboard, Orachrome Lighty, and Enterprise Manager while running dbms_resource_manager.io_calibrate, recording about 120K IOPS and one process sustaining roughly 1.3GB/s.
dbi-services:set-stateapply-off-and-data: Confirms via V$BH block status that stopping Data Guard apply with a broker state change leaves the standby's recovery blocks freed and the datafiles consistent, matching a checkpoint-like alert.log message.
dbi-services:oracle-standard-edition-two: Announces Standard Edition 2 in 12.1.0.2, summarizing the new two-socket rule across single instance and RAC node and socket combinations plus the added fee for customers coming from Standard Edition One.
dbi-services:database-cloud-service-perf: Runs SLOB's cached logical-read workload on a 2-OCPU Oracle Database Cloud Service VM to measure CPU-bound performance, identifying the underlying hardware as an Intel Xeon E5-2690 v2 under Xen and OVM.

Runs SLOB against a Cloud Service storage volume provisioned with the latency option, capturing db file sequential read wait histograms in microsecond buckets on freshly opened European cloud capacity.
dbi-services:slob-in-the-cloud-how-to-ch: Walks through provisioning an Oracle Database Cloud Service VM and a latency-optimized storage volume via the console, then installing SLOB from the command line to benchmark IO performance.
dbi-services:scn-synchronization-in-dist: Explains that Oracle synchronizes SCNs across databases linked in a distributed transaction at each commit, advancing the lowest SCN to match the highest, useful for detecting unexpected db link usage.
dbi-services:oracle-cloud-services-dbaas: Lists best practices for a freshly provisioned DBaaS instance, including lowering swappiness to avoid swapping cold shared-pool memory and disabling automatic expiration on application account passwords.
dbi-services:oracle-cdc-for-datawarehous: Notes that Oracle's built-in Change Data Capture and Streams are deprecated in favor of GoldenGate, proposing Dbvisit Replicate's redo-based logical replication as a lower-cost alternative for datawarehouse refresh.
dbi-services:oracle-database-cloud-servi: Walks through provisioning a full Database as a Service instance with two OCPUs, examining the resulting ext4-mounted storage volumes and the OCPU-to-thread compute shape mapping.
dbi-services:configure-the-resource-mana: Shows configuring Oracle Resource Manager consumer groups and CPU allocation methods through SQL Developer's DBA view in 12c, since dbconsole no longer exists and EM Express lacks that feature.
dbi-services:dataguard-broker-properties: Lists the Data Guard broker log-shipping properties such as LogXptMode, RedoRoutes, and ReopenSecs that are broker-managed but not imported from existing instance parameters when a database joins the configuration.
dbi-services:materialized-view-explain_r: Debugs a 12c query-rewrite failure against a materialized view built on SCOTT.DEPT and EMP, showing rewrite is only accepted once foreign key constraints are enforced, not just declared, and the view is not stale.
dbi-services:dataguard-broker-properties: Lists exactly which instance parameters such as ArchiveLagTarget, DbFileNameConvert, and StandbyFileManagement get imported into Data Guard broker properties when a database is first added to the configuration.
dbi-services:resultcache-hint-expiration: Demonstrates using undocumented RESULT_CACHE hint options to control staleness tolerance, similar to how materialized views can serve slightly outdated results to avoid frequent invalidation on DML.
dbi-services:multitenant-vs-schema-based: Argues most objections to schema-based consolidation such as naming collisions and weak security are overstated, but identifies cursor sharing across schemas as the one genuinely strong reason to prefer PDB isolation.
dbi-services:oracle-log-writer-and-write: Revisits a 20-year-old Oracle 7.2 internals document on write-ahead logging to verify, against Jonathan Lewis's Oracle Core, that DBWR must not write a modified block before LGWR writes its redo.
dbi-services:oracle-database-cloud-servi: Recounts a frustrating first sign-up for Oracle's cloud Database Schema Service trial, including a stray leading space in the emailed username that blocked login until retracing the original activation link.
dbi-services:rac-buffer-states-xcur-scur: Demonstrates RAC Cache Fusion buffer states by querying a block from different instances, showing it move from shared current with a single reader to multiple shared copies as more instances read it via GV$BH.
dbi-services:multithreaded-12c-and-conne: Shows that enabling 12c threaded_execution disables Bequeath OS authentication, so connecting locally as sysdba without a password fails with ORA-01017 unless a password wallet is configured.
dbi-services:2-ways-to-move-archivelogs-: Explains RMAN's CATALOG command can register archivelogs already moved at OS level, while a separate command can move and re-catalog them together, since the controlfile must always reflect the actual file location.
dbi-services:buffer-pool-advisory-in-awr: Validates that DBA_HIST_DB_CACHE_ADVICE's estimated reads at the current buffer size closely track actual physical-reads-cache values across AWR snapshots, confirming advisors reset only at startup.
dbi-services:do-the-block-size-matter: Benchmarks full table scan and index access across 8k, 16k, and 32k block sizes using dedicated cache sizes and locally managed tablespaces, informing a recommendation to keep the default 8k for most workloads.
dbi-services:show-the-top-10-events-from: Shares a script that pulls a specific named section, such as Top 10 Foreground Events, from the latest AWR snapshot via DBMS_WORKLOAD_REPOSITORY.AWR_REPORT_TEXT, filtered with a regexp parameter.
dbi-services:parallel-dml-in-12c: Reproduces a colleague's question about enabling parallel DML at the statement level in 12.1.0.2, testing an insert-select between parallel-defined tables with statistics_level=all to confirm the behavior.
dbi-services:can-you-have-pending-system: Tests whether system statistics, unlike object statistics, support a pending and publish workflow in 11g, comparing full table scan cost estimates before and after altering SYS.AUX_STATS$ values directly.
dbi-services:flame-graph-for-quick-ident: Uses ASH to spot that a 2-hour parse phase precedes execution of a slow query, then captures perf cpu-cycles samples and renders them as a flame graph to visually pinpoint where the parse time is spent.
dbi-services:an-alternative-to-dba_exten: Shares a datafile-map view built on the underlying LMT extent fixed tables instead of DBA_EXTENTS, avoiding costly joins so mapping a file_id and block_id to its segment stays fast with thousands of datafiles.
dbi-services:oracle-memory-advisors-how-: Queries V$DB_CACHE_ADVISOR's estimated physical reads at different buffer sizes and finds the advisor is based on statistics accumulated since instance startup, potentially spanning months of unrepresentative activity.
dbi-services:how-to-disable-a-sql-plan-d: Shows that a SQL Plan Directive disabled a year earlier stays superseded and inactive, but the same predicates recreate a new directive since the disabled one no longer suppresses detection of the misestimate.
dbi-services:convert-a-snapshot-standby-: Documents converting a Data Guard snapshot standby into a permanent independent database with a new name and DBID, useful when the ideal recovery point isn't known in advance and must be found first.
dbi-services:12c-dynamic-sampling-and-st: Explains 12c Adaptive Dynamic Sampling runs its sampling queries with a result-cache snapshot hint so repeated dynamic sampling for the same statement is cached for an hour instead of re-run each time.
dbi-services:how-to-import-sql-plan-dire: Shows packing SQL Plan Directives into a staging table with dbms_spd, then exporting and importing via Data Pump so directives disabled after QA testing can be carried into production in the same state.
dbi-services:dba_sql_plan_directive-last: Demonstrates how the plus-metrics dbms_xplan format reveals which specific SQL Plan Directive ID was used for dynamic sampling in a query, then shows that directive's LAST_USED timestamp updating afterward.
dbi-services:list-all-rman-backups-that-: Argues against relying on backup-job timestamps to identify required restore files when concurrent archivelog backups are allowed, proposing a generated list of exactly the RMAN pieces needed for a point-in-time restore.
dbi-services:variations-on-1m-insert-6-c: Uses perf-captured CPU samples turned into flame graphs to investigate why a 1M-row PL/SQL insert test case takes roughly twice as long in 11.2.0.4 as in 11.2.0.3, zooming into the underlying call path.
dbi-services:variations-on-1m-rows-inser: Switches from VirtualBox to VMware with virtualized CPU performance counters to get valid perf cpu-cycles samples, confirming a 1M-row insert test case consistently takes about twice as long on 11.2.0.4 and 12c.

Tests the 1M-row PL/SQL insert benchmark against a 12c IN MEMORY table, finding it still takes roughly twice as long as the 11.2.0.3 baseline, consistent with a CPU regression rather than an In-Memory-specific effect.
dbi-services:matching-sql-plan-directive: Shows that matching a query to the specific SQL Plan Directive it used requires an EXPLAIN PLAN and reading PLAN_TABLE.OTHER_XML, since V$SQL_PLAN and the plan note alone don't expose the directive ID.

Shows there is no direct link between DBA_SQL_PLAN_DIRECTIVES and DBA_STATS_EXTENSIONS, so matching a directive to the extended statistics it triggered requires parsing each one's differently formatted column list.
dbi-services:variations-on-1m-rows-inser: Adds the APPEND_VALUES hint to a bulk PL/SQL FORALL insert of 1M rows, cutting elapsed time further by performing direct-path inserts straight into the datafile and bypassing the buffer cache.
dbi-services:rebuilt-index-on-increasing: Investigates whether indexes on sequence-generated increasing values need periodic rebuilding after purge-style deletes, using dbms_space and index_stats to check whether freed leaf space is actually reused.
dbi-services:variations-on-1m-rows-inser: Runs the 1M-row insert benchmark against Oracle TimesTen configured with 400MB permanent and 320MB temporary memory via ttIsql, comparing its in-memory OLTP performance against the same test on Oracle Database.
Adds a commit after every row in the 1M-row PL/SQL insert benchmark, measuring the added durability cost of one log file sync wait per row versus committing only once at the end.
Kicks off a benchmark series by timing a single-CPU VM inserting 1 million rows via row-by-row PL/SQL with one primary key index and a single final commit, as the baseline for later comparisons.
dbi-services:a-migration-pitfall-with-al: Reproduces a post-migration performance regression where several histograms went missing despite identical automatic stats-gathering jobs, using a skewed status column and index to demonstrate the pitfall.
dbi-services:list-listeners-and-services: Shows querying the undocumented GV$LISTENER_NETWORK view, available since 11.2, to list every listener including SCAN listeners and their services directly from the instance rather than listener.ora.
dbi-services:alter-table-inmemory: Warns that flipping a table to INMEMORY immediately changes the optimizer's chosen full-table-scan plan to expect the column store even before the table has actually been populated in memory.
dbi-services:c15lv-nothing-to-blog-about: Recaps an IOUG Collaborate panel encouraging reluctant bloggers, then recounts starting on forums like dba-village and developpez.com before Jonathan Lewis's translated-post model inspired an independent blog.
dbi-services:sql-monitor-report-little-i: Notes that 11g SQL Monitoring active reports split CPU and wait-event percentages into separate columns, misleadingly making wait events look dominant, while 12c merges them into one activity-percent column.
dbi-services:yesterdays-awr-straight-to-: Recaps a Collaborate15 AWR-reading talk, noting about half the room lacked Diagnostic Pack, and explains setting Statspack to level 7 so those users can follow the same time-model-to-SQL methodology.
dbi-services:cloning-a-pdb-from-a-standb: Confirms that a single-tenant physical standby opened read-only can serve as the source for PDB cloning, since PDB clone like transportable tablespaces only requires the source to be read-only, not the primary.
dbi-services:rac-attack-was-another-grea: Recaps a hands-on RAC Attack workshop at Collaborate15 where attendees install a RAC cluster on their own laptop from a wikibook cookbook, with VirtualBox and networking misconfiguration as the main exercise.
dbi-services:dbvisit-replicate-redoreadm: Configures Dbvisit Replicate's fetcher process to read only archived logs instead of the online redo logs, reducing the read overhead placed on a production source during a proof of concept.
dbi-services:dataguard-wait-events-have-: Compares an 11g synchronous Data Guard AWR report, where sessions wait behind LNS and LGWR-LNS channel waits, against the renamed and restructured wait events introduced by 12c's new Data Guard network processes.
dbi-services:oracle-tuning-silver-bullet: Demonstrates a full table scan of a padded 10000-row table running over 20 seconds under autotrace, then shows adding an order by makes SQL*Plus appear faster by changing how rows are fetched and displayed.
dbi-services:index-on-truncdate-do-you-s: Extends an earlier trunc-date finding to substring predicates, showing Oracle can use an index on the full string for range predicates on a substring prefix from 12.1.0.2 onward, without a separate index.
dbi-services:standard-edition-on-oracle-: Argues ODA remains a good fit for small companies despite bundling Enterprise Edition by default, since it avoids requiring in-house storage, network, and RAC expertise while offering flash performance and easy HA.
dbi-services:12c-shutdown-abort-a-pdb: Shows that issuing shutdown abort from within a PDB session actually performs a clean close-abort with a full checkpoint, leaving datafiles non-fuzzy, unlike a true instance-crashing shutdown abort at CDB level.
dbi-services:index-on-truncdate-do-you-s: Demonstrates that from 11.2.0.2 the optimizer can use a plain index on a date column for a trunc-date equality predicate without a function-based index, shown by resetting optimizer_features_enable to an older release.
dbi-services:oracle-compression-availabi: Untangles the renamed and overlapping compression features, clarifying which require the Advanced Compression Option, which need Exadata, and which are usable in plain nocompress-only Standard Edition.
dbi-services:generic-query-for-multicrit: Adds the BIND_AWARE hint to an earlier generic multicriteria search query, showing Adaptive Cursor Sharing then generates plan variants keyed to actual bind selectivity instead of sharing one plan for all combinations.

Shows a generic multi-column optional-filter search query on the HR schema shares one plan across all bind combinations, convenient for maintainability but suboptimal versus dynamic SQL or OR expansion.
dbi-services:rac-attack-next-month-12c-i: Previews the RAC Attack workshop at IOUG Collaborate15, describing RAC as spanning storage, network, and application-level failover skills, inviting laptop-equipped attendees to build a 12c cluster hands-on.
dbi-services:query-the-enterprise-manage: Shows querying Enterprise Manager's SYSMAN repository directly for ASM disk group free-space history, joining target and raw metric tables that keep 7 days of detail rather than the coarser hourly and daily aggregates.
dbi-services:12c-online-statistics-gathe: Traces 12c online statistics gathering by enabling a dbms_stats trace flag during an append insert, documenting cases including startup restrict scenarios where online gathering silently doesn't fire.
dbi-services:how-to-set-nls-for-sql-deve: Shows setting Java user.language and file.encoding options when launching SQL Developer's beta command line, needed because its thin JDBC driver ignores NLS_LANG and defaults to the OS locale.
dbi-services:is-cdb-stable-now-after-one: Retests a known 12.1.0.1 bug where losing a PDB's SYSTEM datafile crashed the whole CDB, confirming via RMAN recovery of a dropped non-system tablespace that it is fixed by the 12.1.0.2 patchset with the latest PSU.
dbi-services:oracletext-deletes-and-garb: Continues an OracleText internals series, showing how the token, key, and reverse-lookup index tables are updated when documents are removed, treating an update as a delete plus insert rather than an in-place change.
dbi-services:oracletext-inserts-and-frag: Starts an OracleText internals series showing that inserting a document into a CONTEXT-indexed CLOB column doesn't immediately populate the index tables, since token synchronization is deferred until an explicit sync.
dbi-services:never-gather-workload-stats: Demonstrates that gathering WORKLOAD statistics on Exadata during direct-path reads undercounts MBRC, since those reads aren't counted as multiblock reads, so use the dedicated EXADATA statistics mode instead.
dbi-services:oracle-multitenant-dictiona: Creates a sharing=metadata function in both CDB$ROOT and a PDB, then flushes the shared pool to show how the row cache dictionary component repopulates separately per container for that metadata-linked object.
dbi-services:ioug-collaborate-c15lv: Previews the author's AWR-reading session and RAC Attack ninja participation at IOUG Collaborate 2015 in Las Vegas, linking session details and hands-on cluster-building registration.
dbi-services:flush-one-sql-statement-to-: Shows how to force one specific cursor to hard-parse again without flushing the whole shared pool, illustrated through a bind-variable-peeking demo on a skewed year-of-birth histogram column.
dbi-services:stay-with-non-cdb-or-go-to-: Responds to Oracle's deprecation of the non-CDB architecture by explaining the CDB and PDB dictionary split, user metadata per PDB versus system metadata shared via root links, and what each migration path implies.
dbi-services:when-to-gather-workload-sys: Shares a query against AWR history to chart how irregular WORKLOAD system statistics can be across an 8-day OLTP production period, arguing for either multi-day gathering or manually chosen representative values.
dbi-services:nlslang-on-windows-in-europ: Explains that Windows GUI apps default to WE8MSWIN1252 in the registry, but the DOS console SQL*Plus runs under codepage 850, so NLS_LANG must be set to WE8PC850 to display French accented characters correctly.
dbi-services:flashback-logging-overhead-: Compares tkprof statistics with and without flashback logging enabled, showing flashback logging forces overwritten UNDO blocks to be read from disk before being logged, adding physical reads not seen otherwise.
dbi-services:insert-into-gtt-bulk-with-a: Investigates a GTT accumulating excessive undo from single-row inserts used to pass variable-length value lists, showing bulk inserts with the APPEND_VALUES hint reduce the redo and undo overhead of that pattern.
dbi-services:oracle-multitenant-dictiona: Changes a sharing=metadata function's definition only in CDB$ROOT and observes how the PDB's linked copy reacts, illustrating the mechanism behind 12c's upgrade-by-unplug-plug metadata link resynchronization.

Creates nested sharing=metadata functions in both root and a PDB to study how metadata links resolve dependent objects, building confidence that 12c's link implementation is a robust design rather than a fragile hack.

Investigates AUDIT_ACTIONS as a sharing=object table, showing via ROWID and absolute file number comparison from CDB$ROOT and a PDB that both containers genuinely read the identical underlying shared table rows.
dbi-services:create-schema-synonym-in-or: Discovers commented-out entries referencing an unreleased create-schema-synonym feature, then enables it via an undocumented parameter to test syntax that Oracle never actually shipped in that release.
dbi-services:oracle-lateral-inline-view-: Compares three ways to run dbms_xplan.display_cursor for every statement found in V$SQL: legacy spool-and-rerun, a SQL cursor expression subquery, and 12c's lateral join with implicit statement results.
dbi-services:can-we-disable-logging-for-: Shows a 12c pattern for near-redo-free DML: performing updates in a Global Temporary Table unprotected by redo, then copying results into the permanent table via NOLOGGING direct-path operations under exclusive access.
dbi-services:sqlplus-copy-command-is-bac: Shows the long-deprecated SQL*Plus COPY command reappearing as BRIDGE in the SQL Developer-based sdsql beta, demonstrating cross-database table creation and row copying with the same old syntax.
dbi-services:oracle-12c-comparing-tts-wi: Compares migrating a non-CDB example-schema database to a PDB via transportable tablespaces against using the noncdb_to_pdb script, checking whether the metadata and object-link conversion leaves an equally clean PDB.
dbi-services:when-oracle-resets-session-: Tests whether switching container resets V$MYSTAT session statistics like logon counts, discovering a case where a still-connected session can show zero cumulative logons after switching containers.
dbi-services:12c-privilege-analysis-rock: Uses 12c Privilege Analysis to answer whether a specific dbms_utility function needs special grants beyond create session, discovering it can reveal privileges used internally even by undocumented calls.
dbi-services:oracle-locks-identifiying-b: Shares a V$WAIT_CHAINS-based query displaying the full blocking chain with wait event, minutes waited, and for row locks the specific locked ROWID, to quickly identify the true blocking session rather than only waiters.
dbi-services:12c-sql-plan-directive-stat: Explains the SQL Plan Directive state lifecycle from new through missing-stats to has-stats or permanent, and how the exact transitions changed between the initial 12.1.0.1 release and the 12.1.0.2 patchset.
dbi-services:awr-dont-store-explain-plan: Shows that neither Statspack, which stores zero for predicate columns in its packaging script, nor AWR's display_awr function capture the predicate section, unlike display_cursor against the live shared pool.
dbi-services:12102-cdb-views-are-now-usi: Explains that 12.1.0.2 replaced the undocumented CDB view clause with the documented CONTAINERS table function for CDB_ views, and that a new parameter now hides PDB$SEED from those views by default.
dbi-services:oracle-sql-profile-why-mult: Explains that a SQL Profile's OPT_ESTIMATE hints appear duplicated per query block because internal transformations change query block identifiers, so each transformed variant needs its own matching adjustment.
dbi-services:oracle-sql-profiles-check-w: Shares a query to reveal exactly which cardinality adjustments a SQL Tuning Advisor-proposed SQL Profile will implement before accepting it, useful for spotting the biggest misestimate first.
dbi-services:using-tmux-for-semi-interac: Describes running conference demos standing up with a remote presenter clicking through pre-scripted tmux commands, including a scripted copy-paste of a previous SCN result, avoiding live-typed risky commands.
dbi-services:the-future-of-sqlplus-and-s: Lists SQL*Plus quirks such as an empty comment or a hash-prefixed line re-executing the previous statement, in the context of rumors about an upcoming SQL Developer-based replacement for the aging command line.
dbi-services:how-to-disable-all-database: Shows setting open_links to zero in the spfile and restarting to block all database link connections after an RMAN duplicate, preventing accidental production access from a refreshed test environment.
dbi-services:oracle-cloud-control-sql-de: Clarifies from V$SQL's documented columns that a cursor's first-load time is shared across all child cursors while last-load time differs per child plan, explaining which window the EM statistics tab covers.
dbi-services:oracle-an-unexpected-lock-b: Demonstrates an odd TM lock interaction where a share row exclusive lock released by rollback still leaves a second identical lock request from the same session hanging, despite succeeding immediately the first time.
dbi-services:from-80-extended-rowid-to-1: Traces how the ROWID format evolved from Oracle 7's simple file, block, and row address through Oracle 8's relative file numbers, arguing this early decision later made 12c pluggable databases possible.
dbi-services:what-about-alter-index-shri: Compares COALESCE, REBUILD, and ALTER INDEX SHRINK SPACE for defragmenting a heavily-deleted index, measuring the work done via session statistics and index_stats to show how each operation reclaims leaf space.
dbi-services:oracle-iot-when-to-use-inde: Recommends Index Organized Tables for a many-to-many association table with a composite primary key, since IOTs retrieve all columns fast by primary key while avoiding extra duplicated-column secondary indexes.
dbi-services:oracle-system-statistics-di: Shares a MODEL-clause script displaying both the defined AUX_STATS$ values and Oracle's derived read-time and MBRC calculations, showing how NOWORKLOAD-mode statistics are computed from seek time and transfer speed.
dbi-services:how-i-measure-oracle-index-: Shares a script measuring rows-per-block and free space by value range instead of analyze index validate structure, since wasted index space only matters when deletions leave gaps that won't get new inserts.
dbi-services:how-to-measure-exadata-smar: Explains checking SmartScan efficiency via statistics comparing eligible-for-offload bytes to total read bytes for predicate offloading, storage index effectiveness, and offload bytes returned versus scanned.
dbi-services:do-you-use-oracle-enterpris: Guides checking Enterprise-only feature dependencies before downgrading to Standard Edition, covering the documented EE-feature list as the first of several checks needed before a licensing-driven downgrade.
dbi-services:oracle-how-to-move-omf-data: Demonstrates that in 12c, ALTER DATABASE MOVE DATAFILE with a session-level file destination can relocate OMF-named datafiles online to a new mount point, generated via a script reporting the schema before and after.
dbi-services:resize-your-oracle-datafile: Shares a query against a low-level extent fixed table, avoiding DBA_EXTENTS' expensive joins, to compute each datafile's true high-water-mark extent so resize can shrink files to the minimum without ORA-03297.
dbi-services:whats-the-consequence-of-no: Reproduces the expected consequence of a NOLOGGING direct-path load followed by a media failure before backup completes: recovery restores the tablespace but the loaded table's blocks are unusable, requiring a truncate.
dbi-services:oracle-121021-set-to-join-c: Explains a long-dormant set-to-join transformation, available since 10.1.0.3 but off by default, that converts INTERSECT or MINUS into a join, enabled via a specific optimizer_features_enable value.
dbi-services:12102-wait-event-histograms: Shows that 12.1.0.2's new microsecond wait-event histogram view exposes buckets down to single microseconds, filling a gap left by the millisecond-granularity view now SSD storage pushes most I/O under 1ms.
dbi-services:pdb-media-failure-may-case-: Retests a known 12.1.0.1 bug where losing a PDB's SYSTEM tablespace could crash the entire CDB, checking whether a new undocumented parameter in the 12.1.0.2 patchset actually fixes the underlying issue.
dbi-services:sql-monitoring-12102-shows-: Shows that 12.1.0.2's SQL Monitor now displays Adaptive Plan resolving and resolved states plus both full and final plan views directly in the report, fixing a gap that previously forced relying on dbms_xplan alone.
dbi-services:beyond-in-memory-whats-new-: Surveys 12.1.0.2 patchset features beyond In-Memory, including a buffer-cache big-table caching percentage, a fully-cached database mode, range-partitioned hash clusters, and a new join-to-dimension transformation.
dbi-services:drilling-down-vrecoveryarea: Explains how a low-level fixed table exposes per-file reclaimable status behind the aggregated V$RECOVERY_AREA_USAGE view, needed to compare individual archived logs against backup and retention rather than only totals.
dbi-services:oracle-em-agent-12c-thread-: Diagnoses an Enterprise Manager 12c agent thread leak on Grid Infrastructure using ps to count light-weight processes per PID, then jstack to identify which growing thread stacks approached the OS process limit.
dbi-services:partial-join-evaluation-in-: Demonstrates 12c's Partial Join Evaluation transformation improving semi-join queries written with IN by evaluating only enough of the join to confirm existence, compared against the equivalent 11g execution plan.
dbi-services:oracle-parallel-query-are-y: Argues Oracle Parallel Query has delivered MapReduce-like distributed filter, aggregation, and join scalability for 20 years via a simple ALTER TABLE PARALLEL, illustrated with a basic parallel join execution plan.
dbi-services:linux-how-to-monitor-the-no: Shows counting genuine file-descriptor usage per process against the Linux nofile ulimit by filtering lsof output, since naively counting all lsof lines overcounts entries that aren't actual open descriptors.
dbi-services:linux-how-to-monitor-the-np: Shows that counting processes per user undercounts because Linux implements threads as light-weight processes needing a special ps flag, revealing a system with 1370 processes and threads approaching the nproc limit.
dbi-services:oracle-system-schemas-vs-cr: Surveys ways to distinguish Oracle-maintained schemas from user-created ones, including 12c's oracle-maintained and common-user columns in DBA_USERS, the default password table, and sysaux occupant descriptions.
dbi-services:poor-optimization-for-first: Shows a highly selective query on Exadata performing worse with a full SmartScan table scan than with a forced bad index access, because a first-rows-style stop-key plan still fully sorts and scans before limiting rows.
dbi-services:12c-extended-datatypes-bett: Weighs 12c's extended VARCHAR2, CHAR, and RAW datatypes against CLOB, noting the new types store as chained rows unless created fresh, at which point they behave like LOBs including the same slow row-by-row fetch.
dbi-services:oracle-sql-monitoring-repor: Shows extracting the plain-text execution plan from a 12c SQL Monitoring active report by base64-decoding and zlib-decompressing the embedded XML, since 12c compresses that data unlike the readable 11g report format.
dbi-services:exploring-oracle-se-a-ee-pe: Walks through installing Orachrome Lighty against a Standard Edition database using Statspack instead of AWR, showing its graphical Top Events, Top Segments, and Top SQL views built from a simple JDBC connection.
dbi-services:oracle-rownum-vs-rownumber-: Contrasts ROWNUM and ROW_NUMBER top-n pagination plans, showing ROWNUM's stop-key lets an index range scan stop early while ROW_NUMBER requires evaluating the analytic function first, ahead of 12c's fetch-first syntax.
dbi-services:oracle-12c-cdb-metadata-a-o: Explains that 12c CDB dictionary sharing relies on metadata links for objects like DBMS packages stored only in CDB$ROOT, and object links for shared reference data like AUDIT_ACTIONS and AWR's history repositories.
dbi-services:oracle-12c-adaptive-plan-in: Clarifies that a 12c Adaptive Plan doesn't restart a join method mid-execution but defers the parse-time join-method decision until a statistics collector reads the inflection-point row count from the driving table.
dbi-services:best-practice-to-send-an-or: Recommends capturing execution plans with statistics_level=all and dbms_xplan.display_cursor's allstats and peeked-binds format rather than autotrace, which doesn't reflect actual bind values or row counts.
dbi-services:the-consequences-of-nologgi: Walks through a full RMAN test case showing that restoring a backup taken before a NOLOGGING load leaves that data unrecoverable, requiring manual steps such as truncating the affected table to reach a usable state.
dbi-services:investigating-oracle-lock-i: Shows tracing a delete against a parent table with event 10704 alongside 10046 to reveal locks acquired for unindexed-foreign-key referential integrity checks, explaining which trace lines matter.
dbi-services:oracle-12c-in-memory-option: Previews the pre-release In-Memory option ahead of the 12.1.0.2 patchset, distinguishing it from prior redundant-storage features like TimesTen by its columnar design aimed at reducing CPU rather than I/O.
dbi-services:oracle-partitioned-sequence: Documents an undocumented 12c sequence-partitioning syntax, discoverable via a partition-count column in DBA_SEQUENCES, aimed at easing buffer-busy-wait contention from sequence-driven primary keys.
dbi-services:oracle-et-dbvisit-replicate: French recap of a Dbvisit webinar arguing replication-based migration reduces risk versus a classic upgrade, since it avoids needing full advance knowledge of schemas, synonyms, and triggers.
dbi-services:oracle-is-hanging-dont-forg: Recommends capturing oradebug hanganalyze and systemstate dumps immediately when a database appears fully hung, since a forced shutdown abort destroys the session state and ASH data needed for later root-cause analysis.
dbi-services:archivelog-deletion-policy-: Shows RMAN's applied-on-all-standby deletion policy doesn't automatically make applied archivelogs reclaimable in the FRA before 12c, needing a custom query to check per-archivelog status instead of the summary view.
dbi-services:sockets-cores-virtual-cpu-l: Diagnoses an AIX LPAR AWR report showing only 30% CPU busy despite complaints of 4x slower response, explaining how virtual CPU and hyper-threading hide real CPU starvation behind low utilization.
